subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

I was **discussing about the issue with him**.
solution:
The correct answer is '**discussing the issue with him**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**discussing**" is correctly used without the preposition "about" when referring to the topic of discussion.
 
• Using "about" after "discussing" is redundant and grammatically incorrect.
